ModMetaData.name: DMS - Flogger Weapon Tags / 鞭笞者装备修复
ModMetaData.author: WhiteGiver (local patch)
ModMetaData.description:
为古代军团的鞭笞者机炮补充 DMS_MechWeaponHeavy 和 V_Gatling30mm 装备标签，保留原标签与 2.5 体型要求。不修改其他武器、机体或全局装备限制。纯 XML 独立补丁，无需 Harmony。
Adds the missing Heavy and V_Gatling30mm compatibility tags to AncientCorps' Gsh30-6 Flogger only. Preserves existing tags and its 2.5 body-size requirement. Does not change other weapons, mechs or global equipment rules. XML only; no Harmony required.
